name: Draxie Dust
text:
Frequency once per day

---
You blow a cloud of magical dust and tiny scales, enchanting those who inhale it. Roll 1d6 to determine the dust's effects. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must attempt a Will save save against the higher of your class DC or your spell DC, and is affected as if it got the same outcome on a Will save against the rolled spell.

1–3 The dust has the effects of a 1st-rank Charm spell.

4–6 The dust has the effects of a 1st-rank Sleep spell.
